implemented: Private profile price is now owner-chosen per day with a minimum of 1 USD or stablecoin equivalent.
Visitor chooses the duration in days; the quote computes price_per_day * days.
Creator/Nexus split remains 90/10 for private profile access.
Private Content now has a subscribed-content section that loads posts from active private access receipts.
A local private_profile_access_receipts table models viewer, owner, persona, duration, expiry, split, privacy mode and receipt hash.
Curiosity reveal is modeled as VISITOR_REVEAL_RECIPROCAL with a 2x multiplier and reciprocal access policy, not unilateral visitor exposure.
Demo receipts are status demo_unpaid and never represent real settlement, stablecoin transfer, xMoney payment or on-chain execution.
limitations: The currently running backend process may need a safe restart before new API routes and schema migrations are loaded.
